name: ffdp-web
description: Personal fantasy football tracking app: React + Bun + Tailwind CSS + oRPC + Supabase, with @gurleen-ui as a git submodule.

scripts.build:ui: bun run --cwd vendor/gurleen-ui/packages/tokens --if-present build && bun run --cwd vendor/gurleen-ui/packages/core build && bun run --cwd vendor/gurleen-ui/packages/broadcast build
